eps.t: I've Been Nutmegged, Done Up Like a Kipper
eps.d: While Kinsey and Eddie deal with removing squatters from a shop, Kinsey's Business partner, Barry Haynes, and practice secretary, Linda Barnes, are clearing out funds from a client account and fleeing the country.

eps.t: And I Could Close You Down Tomorrow
eps.d: Following Haynes' exit, Max Barker installs Tricia Mabbott as Kinsey's new partner in residence. Kinsey takes on a case against a driver who has left a young boy in a wheelchair following a road accident.

eps.t: The Authentic Voice... Little Miss Goosestep
eps.d: Kinsey investigates a factory foreman in a case of industrial insurance fraud. Eddie is sent undercover at the factory, but an attempt by the foreman to silence him goes horribly wrong with tragic consequences for one of the workers.

eps.t: What Sort of a Lawyer Are You, Mr. Kinsey?
eps.d: Former Barry Haynes client, designer Kathy McGee has her first fashion show ruined when she suffers an asthma attack. Trisha wants to help but the Medcan inhaler she used has no issue when tested. So why is a Medcan rep visiting Kinsey?

eps.t: Kinsey's Such a Swine to Deal with Normally
eps.d: Lawyer Gordon Sprake is acting for Kinsey's ex-wife's maintenance and is refusing to reduce payment, Kinsey has an old injury case in which Sprake has allowed to run out of time. He asks Trisha to visit Mrs. Clarke and help her sue Sprake.

eps.t: t's Going to Be a Close Call, Kinsey
eps.d: Barry Haynes has fallen from a balcony trying to escape Keith Schofield's man. Linda Barnes returns Haynes home but vanishes with the money and Schofield's files. Kinsey could get struck off, at his tribunal, but must deal with Schofield.

Tricia finds new offices for Kinsey and Mabbott. Marion Blakey needs Kinsey's help in a bid to get her husband's life insurance, following his death. He worked undercover for the army and she may get nothing if he died of drug overdose.

With Tricia taking all her old clients to Kinsey and Mabbutt, Max Barker serves her a writ stop her to practicing. Danny learns Peter Blakely was a police informant and had been held in custody for 17 hours. Kinsey wants the case reopened.

Cosmetic manufacturer Bob Stacy needs Kinsey to negotiate with an animal rights activist who wants £500,000 or he will contaminate his products. Val helps Sheila and Roy when a land developer plans to put up an eyesore next to their home.

Kinsey is heading to Spain to pay the ransom for Bob Stacy. Trisha is hot on Kinsey's trail fearing his real intentions are to re-negotiate the amount. Val has no choice but to represent Roy and Sheila in the upcoming planning hearing.

Trisha and Max Barker are in front of Judge Critchley as Max attempts to stop her working in a three mile radius of her old practice. It is decided the case should go to trial. Kinsey is hired to help remove travelers from private land.

A former client of Tricia, Pat Nye wants to her to represent him but this would leave her open to poaching clients from Max Barker. Louise asks Kinsey to help Harold Jepson who could lose his farm after acting has his son's guarantor..
